core_obligations: Build the double etale presentation with V, U, V' and U' = V' x_V U lying over the base change square of X' over X (proof lines 5342-5361).
For a point u of U over x, use source-and-target locality to identify quasi-finiteness of f at x with quasi-finiteness of U -> V at u, and likewise for f' and U' -> V' (proof lines 5362-5370).
Reduce parts (1), (2) and (3) to the scheme statements about the quasi-finite locus and its base change (proof lines 5371-5373).
Derive part (4) from part (3) together with stability of quasi-compactness under base change (proof line 5374).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with four assertions for a locally finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces and its base change f' by g : Y' -> Y: the quasi-finite loci W and W' are open, W' is the preimage of W, and locally quasi-finite (resp. quasi-finite) morphisms are stable under base change (source lines 5323-5339). The proof replaces the two morphisms by morphisms of schemes through a double etale presentation U -> V and U' = V' x_V U -> V', uses that local quasi-finiteness is etale local on the source-and-target to translate 'quasi-finite at x' into a statement about U -> V at a chosen point u, and then invokes the scheme case for the openness of the locus, for its base change compatibility and for stability under base change, finishing the quasi-finite case with the quasi-compactness input.
